minegit.prune.description: WARNING: This feature currently causes issues when syncing worlds across multiple devices. A fix will be implemented in a future update of MineGIT. This will delete all but the most recent version of your world both locally and from cloud storage. You will no longer be able to restore old snapshots of your world, but it will reduce the world's file size.
